LanguageData.MooGirl_MilitaryDress.description: A full Mugirl regulation military dress uniform finalized by the Equipment Design Bureau in 5495. Made throughout from advanced military synthetic fibers, it balances durability with a dignified tailored fit and is praised for its excellent windproof warmth. This model covers the whole body, and its memory fabric quickly adapts to body contours to improve appearance. Within Mugirl armed forces, it is gradually replacing older regulations as the standard for formal occasions.
LanguageData.MooGirl_MilitaryDress.label: Mugirl Full Military Dress Uniform
LanguageData.MooGirl_MilitaryUniform.description: A lightweight Mugirl regulation military dress uniform finalized by the Equipment Design Bureau in 5495. Made throughout from advanced military synthetic fibers, it balances durability with a dignified tailored fit and is praised for its excellent breathability and heat dissipation. To better fit close-worn garments, this model compromises with cutouts around the torso, while its memory fabric quickly adapts to body contours to improve appearance. Within Mugirl armed forces, it is gradually replacing older regulations as the standard for formal occasions.
